policyAdopted.REQUIRED_CORE: inside the official instructional scope, whether or not summatively assessed
policyAdopted.REQUIRED_PREREQUISITE: required because downstream required content depends on it
policyAdopted.OPTIONAL_ENRICHMENT: available but OUTSIDE the official instructional scope and not required downstream

history.inconsistency: The CBSE formative-only preamble states these topics are "included in the syllabus but will be assessed only formatively". Under the policy above, inclusion in the syllabus places a topic inside the official instructional scope, so OPTIONAL_ENRICHMENT contradicts the source for every CBSE formative topic.
